item.title: The best local co-op games to play in 2026
item.description: As we approach the colder months, it's becoming the time when sitting inside and playing some of the best local co-op games is looking more and more appealing. Even though couch co-op and split-screen play is often pushed to the side in favor of online co-op, there are still plenty of modern games that allow players to sit side-by-side and play together. And believe it or not, some of those games are great!

item.title: 6 Perfect Star Trek Episodes to Watch to Say Goodbye to Patrick Stewart
item.description: Even more significant than the quantity of Star Trek that Stewart made was the quality. Kirk is in many ways a classic pulp action hero. He faces conflicts head on, never afraid to throw a punch or flirt with a sexy alien. Picard represents a different form of masculinity, valuing compassion, knowledge, and communication above all else. He is the endlessly patient father figure for his crew, and for the next generation of Star Trek viewers, presiding over one of the most beautiful visions of what the future could look like. It’s that connection that has left fans in mourning following his death on Thursday at the age of 86.

item.title: Doom Creator John Romero Revives Xbox-Canceled Game At New Publisher
item.description: The fate of the next game from Doom creator John Romero was in jeopardy after Xbox canceled the project last year. Thankfully, Romero confirmed in a new interview that the project will see the light of day, as his studio has found another publisher.

item.title: A Persona 1 Remake Is In Development, New Leak Suggests
item.description: Persona 4 Revival and Persona 6 aren't even out yet, and another Persona game has already leaked. Fittingly for Halloween, some new footage of an in-development Persona remake emerged online. It appears to be for a remake of Revelations: Persona , the first game in the series.

item.title: Itch.io Reveals Just How Much AI Slop Is Flooding Gaming Storefronts
item.description: A quick glance at Steam or itch.io shows how gaming storefronts are flooded with new games as more developers use generative AI, making it harder than ever for indie devs with hand-crafted games to stand out. A recent social media post by itch.io revealed some new data highlighting just how bad the situation has become.

item.title: New Fortnite Item Makes Everything on the Item Shop Completely Free
item.description: Fortnite Treasure Hunters is here at last. This season is all about pirates and plundering treasure. Players can look the part using the Straw Hat Pirates skins from One Piece . It can get expensive to purchase cosmetics in Fortnite , but this season, there's an in-game item that makes everything in the Item Shop free. It almost sounds too good to be true, but it's real, and it's out there on the Battle Royale island.

item.title: Animal Crossing Is Finally Getting Some Real Competition With Petit Planet for Switch 2 In 2027
item.description: Many Animal Crossing competitors have emerged since New Horizons became a breakout success in 2020 , but few have a chance to take on the popular Nintendo series like HoYoverse's Petit Planet . Now, we've learned that a showdown between the two games will take place on Nintendo Switch 2, as a release window for a port was recently confirmed.

item.title: The 10 Most Anticipated Sci-Fi and Fantasy Books of November 2026
item.description: When fall brings cold, windy, and wet weather, it’s the perfect time to stay inside and curl up with a good book. November offers plenty of options, with fresh entries in long-running series, standalones by bestselling authors, and brand-new talent to check out. Whether you want to imagine sailing with sky pirates, exploring a haunted forest, or flirting with faeries, the 10 most anticipated sci-fi and fantasy books of November offer plenty of ways to pass a rainy day.

item.title: 15 Years Ago, Zelda Told its Most Memorable Story with its Worst Gameplay
item.description: Hold the controller over your head. The Master Sword glows. Point it at the screen, hit Y to recenter, and swing. On the screen, Link swings… kind of the right way. Then, your chatty companion, Fi, chimes in with a very long and earnest explanation of something you figured out several minutes ago. Rinse and repeat for about 40 hours, and that’s Skyward Sword , one of the most cinematic, heartrending, memorable stories Zelda has ever told — and the one saddled with the most finicky gameplay.

item.title: Dungeons & Dragons Turned Hansel and Gretel Into a Near-Perfect Adventure
item.description: Most of the published adventures for Dungeons & Dragons focus on epic fantasy , tasking players with fighting ancient necromancers, rampaging demons, or invading armies in order to prevent some great calamity. But the stakes don’t have to be so high to have a great session, and a bit of whimsy can prove just as memorable as a dramatic battle. That’s why one of my favorite adventures from Wizards of the Coast is a silly fairy tale inspired by Hansel and Gretel.
